question.description: The assessment question to evaluate for standards alignment

statementCode.description: Math standard code to evaluate against (e.g. '3.MD.C.7.d', 'K.CC.A.1').

jurisdiction.description: Standards jurisdiction — 'Multi-State' for CCSS, or a specific state name (e.g. 'California', 'Texas'). Determines which framework the standard code is resolved against.
